weekend_note: Hurricane Isaias is expected to reach the northern Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, with about 90 percent rain Friday, 40 percent Saturday and a drier Sunday. Evacuation is ordered for Zones A and B, which include Pensacola Beach and Perdido Key. The City has canceled events and permits through Sunday, and the Saenger, Festa Italiana, the Southern Tip Off, UWF football and the Blue Wahoos game are all off. Treat anything else this weekend as unconfirmed until the organizer says otherwise. The picks below are next-week events and are subject to storm recovery. Only the Ice Flyers game is indoors.

news.title: Hurricane Isaias: evacuations ordered for Escambia Zones A and B
news.summary: Landfall is expected on the northern Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday. The order, which took effect at noon Thursday, covers Pensacola Beach, Perdido Key, Innerarity Point, low-lying areas and mobile homes. Shelters opened at 3 PM: Pensacola Bay Center for the general public and Wedgewood Community Center for special needs.

news.title: City and county closures for Isaias
news.summary: County offices are closed Friday, and city offices close Thursday at 2 PM and stay closed Friday. City events and permits are canceled through Sunday. The airport terminal closes to commercial flights at 10 AM Friday. Pensacola and Perdido Key visitor centers are closed, with a goal of reopening Sunday.

news.title: Festa Italiana moved to mid-November
news.summary: Organizers postponed the festival to Nov 13 and 14 at Fountain Park, with free admission and 11 AM to 6 PM hours.

news.title: Weekend games and shows called off
news.summary: The Southern Tip Off at the Bay Center and UWF's home football game are canceled, as is the Blue Wahoos' FSU-Auburn exhibition. The Saenger lists its Thursday through Saturday shows as postponed.

news.title: Schools in Escambia close Friday
news.summary: Escambia schools and district offices are closed Friday, and Monday Oct 12 is already a student holiday. Santa Rosa and Okaloosa have also closed schools.

news.title: Utilities expect storm outages
news.summary: FPL and ECUA are staging crews and supplies. FPL says outages should be expected, and residents are asked to secure bins and have a plan ready.

news.title: Hurlburt Field housing evacuated
news.summary: About 1,000 residents of privatized housing and the FAMCamp were told to leave by 5 PM Thursday because rising water could affect a base utility lift station. The base says this is not a wider evacuation.

news.title: Free sand available for storm prep in Escambia
news.summary: NorthEscambia.com reports the county is offering free sand to residents; the article page was not opened, so locations are not listed here.

coverage_note: Written the night of Oct 8 while Hurricane Isaias approaches, so the situation is changing fast; confirm anything on the beach or outdoors with the organizer. Weather is the NWS point forecast issued 4:16 PM CDT Oct 8: Thursday's high was not listed so 84 is carried from the earlier forecast, and Sunday through Wednesday rain chances were not stated in the text, so 10 percent is a placeholder. Events after the storm come from Must Do Pensacola, PensacolaBeach.com, WEAR and the Saenger site; many have no storm update, and those are marked. The Saenger, Bay Center, UWF and Blue Wahoos cancellations are confirmed. Visit Pensacola's songwriter page was a 2025 listing, so the festival status is unclear. North and west Escambia coverage is NorthEscambia.com headlines plus county library classes; Gonzalez and Perdido Key listings are thin, and Facebook-only events are not covered. Restaurant statuses are unchanged and Pelican Bar and Grill and Casa Luvia are still unconfirmed.
